Nuclear fusion is potentially the last energy technology humanity will ever need. So why don’t we have it yet? Despite major breakthroughs, fusion reactors still face enormous engineering challenges. From extreme temperatures to neutron radiation and material limitations, building a working fusion power plant may be the single hardest problem humans have ever tackled. So is fusion really just “10 years away”? Noted Dude-terium Kyle Hill explains.
